title: Search Console CLI
summary: Google Search Console from the terminal with no packages to install: submit your sitemap, inspect whether Google has indexed a URL, and pull the queries ranking 11-20 that are your cheapest SEO wins. Includes a one-page phone flow to approve the Google sign-in when the Mac is headless.
how_to_use: Set up a Desktop OAuth client once (README), then: gsc.py submit-sitemap, gsc.py inspect /some-page, gsc.py queries --min-pos 11 --max-pos 20. Ask Claude: 'check what Google has indexed on my site'.
requires: Python 3 (built in on macOS), a Google Cloud OAuth Desktop client with the Search Console API enabled, and a Search Console property you own.
